stories.headline: Nvidia shares drop 6.4% as board investigates CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary: Trump says the FBI is "looking into" Huang after reports of his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy; the board investigation continues and shares fell Monday.

stories.headline: Anthropic mistakenly emails IPO details, reveals $69.3B fundraising
stories.summary: Anthropic reportedly plans to move ahead with an IPO, with a valuation range expected this week; a mistaken email spilled fundraising details.

stories.headline: GTA 6 is done — gone gold, preload live ahead of Nov 19 launch
stories.summary: Take-Two confirmed on Monday's earnings call that development is complete; preload is live now (up to 212 GB), launching Nov 19 on PS5/Xbox at $79.99.

stories.headline: Warhammer Survivors out today on PC, consoles and phones
stories.summary: A Vampire Survivors-style bullet-heaven from Auroch Digital and poncle, set in Warhammer 40,000 and Age of Sigmar — $7.19 with the launch discount.

stories.headline: Russia–Ukraine peace talks open in Abu Dhabi
stories.summary: US-mediated talks, the first since February, as negotiators seek an end to more than four years of war.

stories.headline: France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guard for supermarket fridge cyberattacks
stories.summary: October attacks raised the temperature of supermarket refrigeration across France; Paris calls it the first cyber offensive carried out purely to sabotage national territory.

stories.headline: M. John Harrison, 81, wins the Booker Prize
stories.summary: Won for 'The End of Everything', one of the oldest winners ever.
